tiers.name: Naive `F.cross_entropy(..., reduction='mean') / grad_accum_steps` + DP Mean
tiers.note: A 32-token response gets weighted by 1/(32*8*8), whereas a 2,560-token response gets 1/(2560*8*8) -> short-response tokens have 80x higher gradient weight!

tiers.name: Local Rank Token-Sum Normalization (`loss_sum / local_rank_tokens`, No Cross-DP Token Sync)
tiers.note: Fixes intra-rank microbatch skew, but when Rank 0 has 1,200 valid tokens and Rank 1 has 7,680 valid tokens, DDP/FSDP averages them with a 6.4x cross-rank bias!

tiers.name: Sequence-Level Equal Weighting (Each Prompt Weighted Equally Regardless of Length)
tiers.note: Penalizes long chain-of-thought tokens relative to 1-word answers, causing premature EOS termination and length collapse in RL/SFT!

tiers.name: `reduction='sum'` + Global `All-Reduce(total_valid_tokens)` Across All `K` Microsteps & `DP` Ranks
tiers.note: Scales each microbatch sum by `dp_world_size / global_valid_tokens` -> 1.0x uniform token weight, 0.0% deviation from full batch, and +9.4% long-form accuracy!
